explanation: All 24 kinematic points passed preflight (W=1.6 GeV > 1.4861 threshold, Q2=1.0 GeV^2 positive, cos(theta*)=0.0 safe, phi 0-345 in 15-degree steps). The request asked for '25 points, phi* from 0 to 345 in 25 steps' — phi from 0 to 345 in steps of 15 degrees yields 24 distinct points (0, 15, 30, ..., 345), not 25. This is the most natural reading of the request; if 25 points were truly needed, phi would need to span 0-360 in 15-degree steps (or 0-345 in ~14.79-degree steps). Generated 3 chunked input files (10+10+4) per the tool's 10-point-per-file convention. Beam energy 6.53 GeV was supplied by the caller (CLAS12 RG-K, the validated eta campaign). rc_mode=full (O-alpha) used — the validated mode for all published eta results. vcut=0.166 GeV^2 from channel default. Runs near W~1.6 GeV are not near threshold (1.4861 GeV) so no special hang risk, but the runner should still use a timeout as the integrator can hang on unphysical points.
